issues.explanation: No migration in diff for queues.priority_prefix_map or tickets.issue_date, backfill, non-nullable change, unique index replacement, or down().
Queue has no saving validation throwing InvalidArgumentException and no empty-map-to-null normalization on every save.
Ticket shows no issue_date date cast so $ticket->issue_date->toDateString() cannot work.
No fillable/guarded change shown so Queue::factory()->create(['priority_prefix_map' => [...]]) may fail mass-assignment.
IssueTicket calls now() separately for issueDate and issued_at, allowing midnight split instead of one instant.
TicketFactory defaults issue_date to now() and creating callback never realigns issue_date to issued_at, so dated tickets are misaligned.
Docs updates for Display code, database schema, and CHANGELOG are absent from the diff.
No Pest/PHPUnit tests ship with the change despite TDD requiring tests for every feature.
Missing generated reversible migration violates migrations must use artisan generators with down().
Misaligned indentation on issueDate/nextCode lines breaks sibling style.

review.summary: Adds prefix-aware daily sequencing core logic correctly, but cannot work as a PR: persistence migrations, model-level validation/normalization, date cast, single-clock issuance, factory date alignment, docs, and tests are missing or wrong.
